headline: Full time: FC Northbridge 1-1 Harbour City
body: We fought for every inch and Sergio Strand’s goal at 13' gave us the lead that felt like ours. We were punished straight after the break by Nakamura at 46', and the draw stings because we wanted all three. We created chances — at 9 carrying on would have raised the chance to score to 10.1%, and at 37 carrying on would have raised the chance to score to 11.5%. This was us: brave, clever in parts, and just short of the finish line.
